blocks.comment: The rock of a cave, seen from any side alike (its wall, its roof, its floor): blocks of limestone parted by cracks, its mottles and flecks, the hollows the water ate in it and the smooth crust of calcite it left in patches. Nothing in it runs one way, so it is drawn from all three sides of the place. Its colors are neutral: a ground tints it by the rock there.
